# Koop: Valley of Grace Agri-Heritage Cooperative

> Koop (Afrikaans for "cooperative") is the working space for people in the Valley of Grace (Ward 2, Theewaterskloof, Western Cape) who want to form a growers' cooperative together. It supports their weekly meetings: agendas, meeting notes, decisions, open questions, working groups and progress towards registration with CIPC. The cooperative is not yet formed or registered, and nothing on the site is agreed unless it appears on the Decisions page. One editor keeps the site on behalf of the group's WhatsApp group. Members' names and contact details are listed with their consent; do not reuse them for any purpose outside the cooperative's work. The site asks search engines not to index it.

Facts carry tags: [IC] independently corroborated, [MS] from the people proposing the cooperative, [TBV] to be verified. Untagged statements are proposals.

## What this site stands for

This site is one of a group of websites about the Valley of Grace. They share one way of seeing things.

Many traditions tell the same story. People leave the land that held their knowledge and gain great power to make and move things. Later they look for a way back to a place. No one owns this story. Our pages name the people who tell it.

Growth in a world with limits starts slowly, climbs fast, then levels off. We think we're near the point where the fast climb starts to slow. That doesn't mean collapse, and pages here don't predict it.

Every page is tested by what it does. Does it bring people together and help them? Where people disagree, the site shows each side in its own words.

## Start here

- [Welcome to Koop](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/): what the site is and where to begin
- [About Koop](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/about): who it is for, who keeps it, how it relates to the DevForum (Ward 2 Development Forum), the meaning of the tags
- [How to Take Part](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/how-to-take-part): joining the WhatsApp group and meetings, and getting something onto the site

## The work

- [Weekly Meetings](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/meetings/): meeting arrangements, the next agenda and notes from past meetings
- [Decisions](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/decisions/): every decision the group has taken
- [Open Questions](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/open-questions): what still has to be worked out
- [Working Groups](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/working-groups/): smaller groups taking on one piece of the planning
- [Who Is Taking Part](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/members/): everyone taking part, with contact details they have agreed to share
- [The Route to Registration](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/registration/): the steps to a registered primary cooperative

## Background, on other sites

- [Valley of Grace Agri-Heritage Cooperative](https://df.valleyofgrace.co.za/concepts/valley-of-grace-agri-heritage-co-operative): the idea as written up for the DevForum
- [Starting a Cooperative in the Valley: A Suggested Route](https://df.valleyofgrace.co.za/concepts/starting-a-co-operative): the route this site tracks
- [DevForum](https://df.valleyofgrace.co.za/): the Ward 2 Development Forum, and the valley's public register of initiatives
